entries.target: A short range attack that deals damage to 1 target.
entries.officialDescription: Strike your target with your Energy Blade. Deals damage and applies Lacerated, reducing your target’s Dodge by 20% for 2 seconds while restoring extra mana to yourself. Also applies additional effects based on your active Alignment.
notes: If Wolfblade Allegiance! is active, applies Thick Skin, an HoT for 4 seconds to the caster.
If Runehawk Allegiance! is active, applies Rift Heal, an HoT for 4 seconds to the caster.
If Mystraven Allegiance! is active, applies Shredder, increases DoT damage by 100% for 5 seconds.
